instruction: I'm collecting references for my paper on conversational AI. The docx file has several papers listed. Please export the DBLP bibtex for the CoSQL paper (Conversational Text-to-SQL) to 'references.bib'. Use the published version, not arxiv. Add a blank line after the entry.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting bibtex for the specific CoSQL paper using the published version (not arxiv) with a blank line after the entry. Evaluator parses the bibtex file and verifies: 1) file has content, 2) content mentions CoSQL or Conversational Text-to-SQL, 3) uses published entry type (@inproceedings or @article) without arxiv references, 4) has blank line after the entry.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if all requirements met (correct paper, published version, blank line), 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all four requirements: file content, CoSQL paper identification, published version verification, and blank line after entry.
CoSQL paper detection: Uses multiple heuristics (CoSQL keyword, 'Conversational'+'Text-to-SQL', author names) to identify the correct paper. Covers reasonable variations.
Published version check: Correctly verifies entry type is @inproceedings or @article and does not contain 'arxiv' references.
Blank line verification: Checks for blank line after entry using regex patterns.
Minor issue - author name check weakness: Line 51 checks for common surnames (Yu|Tao|Zhang|Radev) which could match unrelated papers, but combined with other checks this is acceptable.

Minor issue - blank line regex: Lines 71-74 use regex that searches anywhere in content rather than strictly at the end. Could incorrectly pass if multiple entries exist and only a non-CoSQL entry has blank line. However, for typical single-entry case this will work correctly.
Minor issue - redundant arxiv check: Line 58 has redundant case check (both case-insensitive and exact 'arXiv'), but this doesn't affect correctness.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions:
Improve blank line detection to strictly check at end of file: use pattern like r'\}\s*
\s*
\s*$' with re.search or check that content.rstrip() ends with '}
' and has trailing blank lines.
Consider making author check more specific to CoSQL paper (e.g., check for specific first+last name combinations like 'Tao Yu' or 'Victor Zhong') to reduce false positives.
For multi-entry files, extract individual entries and verify the CoSQL-matching entry specifically has the blank line, rather than checking if any entry has it.
